bot_question_flow.question: What type of cleaning do you need?
bot_question_flow.why: Determines base price range — post-construction is always higher than regular

bot_question_flow.question: How many bedrooms and bathrooms does the space have? (or approximate sq ft if commercial)
bot_question_flow.why: Primary pricing factor — determines time and crew size needed

bot_question_flow.question: When do you need it done? Do you have a specific date or is it flexible?
bot_question_flow.why: Same-day or next-day adds urgency fee. Flexible = standard rate

bot_question_flow.question: How would you describe the current condition of the space — move-in ready condition, average, or pretty rough?
options: Move-in ready — just needs a refresh
bot_question_flow.why: Rough condition means more hours. This prevents underquoting

bot_reply_templates.label: Standard quote request
bot_reply_templates.trigger: They ask for price, quote, estimate, or how much
bot_reply_templates.comment:
Happy to get you a quote! Just need a few quick details:

1️⃣ What type of cleaning? (move-out, post-construction, regular deep clean)
2️⃣ How many bedrooms/bathrooms? (or sq ft if it's a commercial space)
3️⃣ When do you need it — any specific date?
4️⃣ How's the current condition — average, or has it seen better days? 😄

Once we have that, we'll send you the exact number right away!
notes: Casual opener — 'Happy to' not 'We would be pleased to'
4 questions in one comment — numbered for easy reading on mobile
Question 4 uses light humor ('seen better days') to keep it human
'Exact number right away' = sets expectation that María responds fast via DM
No price ranges given publicly — avoids competitors seeing your rates

bot_reply_templates.label: When they just say 'how much?' with no context
bot_reply_templates.trigger: Very short reply — just 'how much?' or 'what's your price?'
bot_reply_templates.comment: Depends on the job! Quick question — what type of cleaning and roughly how big is the space? We'll get you a number fast 🧹
notes: Matches their brevity — they were short, bot is short
Two questions only — size and type are the minimum to give any range
'We'll get you a number fast' = manages expectation without promising a specific time

bot_reply_templates.label: When they signal urgency
bot_reply_templates.comment: We got you — we do last minute jobs in Chicago. What type of cleaning and how big is the space? We'll get you a quote in minutes and let you know our availability 🧹
notes: 'We got you' = matches their urgency energy immediately
Only asks 2 questions — urgency means less time to answer 4
'Quote in minutes' = realistic if María is available
Triggers URGENT flag in alert to María
